intro: Maximize your system's hardware potential. This section contains optimizations designed to reduce input lag, improve frame rates, and eliminate system stutters during gaming or intensive workloads.
For settings with "Absence = Enabled", the feature is ON when the registry key doesn't exist (Windows default behavior). Winhance creates the key to disable the feature.

html:
Service Recommendations

It is recommended to set non-essential services to Manual rather than Disabled. This ensures they don't consume resources at startup but can still be started by Windows if a specific application needs them.

Custom Mode Required

The following individual visual effects settings require Visual Effects to be set to "Custom" mode (value 3) to take effect. Winhance automatically sets Custom mode when you toggle any of these individual settings, so you don't need to manually change it first.
